t: This is the church of St Ethelburga, on Bishopsgate near Liverpool Street station. It is a Church of England church in the City of London. Several people are buried here. Sir Hugh Hamersley, a merchant, was Lord Mayor of London in 1627, and he is buried here. So is William Innes, a merchant who sat in the House of Commons in the 1770s. Elizabeth Waller and Abigail Campbell are also buried here. It is a small church standing among the much larger buildings of the City.
